is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Page 1, 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotypes the kdr (Vgsc L995F) and Ace1R (Ace-1 G280S) mutations (Page 3, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (Page 3) provides allele frequencies and the number of mosquitoes tested for kdr and Ace1R. Table 3 (Page 6) provides frequencies for survivors and dead mosquitoes across different treatments.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the village of VK7, valley of the Kou River, near Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing an experimental hut trial (Page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is tied to the village of VK7, near Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted in May–June and September–October 2006 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes routine new collections for an experimental hut trial in VK7 village, Burkina Faso.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype and bioassay data are provided in the main text and tables (Tables 1 and 3).

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of insecticide-repellent mixtures on bed nets against Anopheles gambiae in Burkina Faso. It reports Vgsc L995F (kdr) and Ace-1 G280S (Ace1R) allele frequencies for field-collected mosquitoes across two seasons in 2006. It also provides genotype-phenotype data by comparing marker frequencies between survivors and dead mosquitoes from experimental hut trials.
